{"n": 184, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Kdeže, ružová je jej štýl, ale práve teraz ona perie biele tričko.", "pronoun": "ona", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3sg subject of coordinate main clause 'perie'; EN 'she'"},
{"n": 185, "action": "R", "sk_new": "On urobí modelkám niekoľko fotiek.", "pronoun": "on", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3sg subject of 'urobí'; EN 'he'"},
{"n": 186, "action": "U", "sk_new": "On drží oranžový balíček vysoko nad hlavou.", "pronoun": null, "where": null, "reason": "explicit_subject"},
{"n": 187, "action": "R", "sk_new": "V lese on roztiahne svoje ruky doširoka.", "pronoun": "on", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3sg subject of 'roztiahne'; EN 'he'"},
{"n": 188, "action": "U", "sk_new": "Kámo, on je málokedy smutný, ale dnes ráno mu dážď celkom pokazil piknik.", "pronoun": null, "where": null, "reason": "explicit_subject"},
{"n": 189, "action": "R", "sk_new": "More by si ty mal maľovať, keď je dobré svetlo.", "pronoun": "ty", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 2sg masc subject of 'by si mal'"},
{"n": 190, "action": "R", "sk_new": "On je šťastný a poslednú časť stavia rýchlo.", "pronoun": "on", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3sg masc subject of 'je šťastný'; EN 'he'"},
{"n": 191, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Ten veľký dom je drahý, tak by ona mala nájsť si prácu.", "pronoun": "ona", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3sg fem subject of coordinate clause 'by mala'; EN 'she'"},
{"n": 192, "action": "U", "sk_new": "Toto tiché jazero je ideálne na rybárčenie.", "pronoun": null, "where": null, "reason": "explicit_subject"},
{"n": 193, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Pozri na jeho kapucňu! On sa chystá poprosiť o miesto.", "pronoun": "on", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3sg subject of 'chystá sa'; EN 'he'"},
{"n": 194, "action": "U", "sk_new": "Brácho, ak bude dav takto jasať ďalej, táto kampaň vyhrá celé to, bez kecov.", "pronoun": null, "where": null, "reason": "explicit_subject"},
{"n": 195, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Oni išli po pláži, keď zrazu zdvihli motorky do vzpriamenej polohy.", "pronoun": "oni", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3pl subject of 'išli'; EN 'they'"},
{"n": 196, "action": "U", "sk_new": "Mačiatko naháňa zelenú loptičku okolo veže už desať minút.", "pronoun": null, "where": null, "reason": "explicit_subject"},
{"n": 197, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Často sa tu prechádza, ale teraz ona pózuje na fotku.", "pronoun": "ona", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3sg subject of coordinate main clause 'pózuje'; EN 'she'"},
{"n": 198, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Práve teraz sa on prediera preplnenou chodbou metra.", "pronoun": "on", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3sg subject of 'prediera sa'; EN 'he'"},
{"n": 199, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Nemala to ona skúšať sama — hrazda bola príliš vysoko.", "pronoun": "ona", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3sg fem subject of 'nemala'; EN 'she'"},
{"n": 200, "action": "U", "sk_new": "Nočná mora! Korytnačka zvyčajne pláva voľne, ale teraz ju panda tesne stíska!", "pronoun": null, "where": null, "reason": "explicit_subject"},
{"n": 201, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Môžeš ty ochutnať syr, kým ho kúpiš?", "pronoun": "ty", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 2sg subject of 'môžeš'"},
{"n": 202, "action": "U", "sk_new": "On má v náklade dva stohy.", "pronoun": null, "where": null, "reason": "explicit_subject"},
{"n": 203, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Žiadna brada? Dobre, požičiam ti ja svoj hrebeň!", "pronoun": "ja", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 1sg subject of 'požičiam'"},
{"n": 204, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Keby si ona nebola dala ruky v bok, trieda by nebola napodobnila tú pozíciu.", "pronoun": "ona", "where": "embedded", "reason": "main subject 'trieda' overt; dropped 3sg fem subject in keby-clause; EN 'she'"},
{"n": 205, "action": "U", "sk_new": "Na poličke je jedna fľaša šampónu a dva hrebene.", "pronoun": null, "where": null, "reason": "explicit_subject"},
{"n": 206, "action": "R", "sk_new": "Uhorku on krája veľmi opatrne", "pronoun": "on", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3sg subject of 'krája'; EN 'he'"},
{"n": 207, "action": "R", "sk_new": "V tejto chvíli sa on točí dokola pod billboardmi s roztiahnutými rukami.", "pronoun": "on", "where": "main", "reason": "dropped 3sg subject of 'točí sa'; EN 'he'"},

{"n": 209, "action": "U", "sk_new": "Dáma sedí pri stole v záhrade.", "pronoun": null, "where": null, "reason": "explicit_subject"},
